title: Zero maximum flow and minimum cut without a positive-capacity path
statement: Let $N$ be a network with distinguished single source $x$ and single sink $y$, and suppose there is no directed path from $x$ to $y$ every arc of which has positive capacity. Then every maximum flow $f$ in $N$ has value $0$, and every minimum cut $S$ (a vertex set with $x \in S$ and $y \notin S$) has capacity $0$.
hypotheses_covered: no directed path from x to y through arcs of positive capacity
f is a maximum flow in N
S is a minimum cut in N
replaced:
\emph{If there exists no directed \texttt{(x, y)}-path in \texttt{N}, then the
value of a maximum flow and the capacity of a minimum cut are both zero.}
